name: "Pumpkin Patch" Chocolate Pudding & Pumpkin Mousse Cups with Cookie Crumbs (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Place a medium bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)
Place milk and pudding mix in another medium bowl. Using a hand-held electric mixer or whisk, beat on low speed for 2 minutes. Place in the fridge and chill until set, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (5.9 oz) box instant pudding mix, chocolate flavored
3 cups whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place cookies in a resealable plastic bag and have fun crushing them into "dirt." (Use your hands, a flat-bottomed glass, rolling pin, or small saucepan to help!) Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Place coconut and food coloring in another small bowl, then stir until the coconut "grass" is evenly green (add more food coloring to reach your desired color). Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp shredded unsweetened coconut
2 drop green food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Using a box grater, coarsely grate cream cheese into a third medium bowl; add cinnamon and nutmeg. Use a silicone spatula or fork to soften and combine the cream cheese mixture, creating a smooth cream.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 oz) block cream cheese
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
⅛ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer, sift powdered sugar into the bowl with the cream cheese. Use the spatula or fork to mash and combine the mixture until smooth and no lumps remain. Add pumpkin, stir to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup powdered sugar
1 (15 oz) can pure pumpkin purée

instructions.primary_message: Remove bowl from the freezer. Place cold cream, additional sugar, and vanilla in the bowl; use the hand-held mixer or whisk to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 2 minutes. (When you pull the blender out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup heavy whipping cream
powdered sugar
½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the whipped cream to the bowl with the pumpkin mixture. Using a silicone spatula, gently fold the two together to combine the pumpkin mousse.

Place a tablespoon of cookie dirt in the bottom of each cup. Layer each cup with a ½-cup of pumpkin mousse, an additional tablespoon of dirt, a ½-cup of chocolate pudding, then top with a final tablespoon of dirt. Sprinkle with a pinch of coconut grass, then add pumpkin candies to complete your "pumpkin patch."
Show off your creations, share, and enjoy!
